new_findings.title: New application pixel correction hides a shared manager focus bar after drawing the help card
new_findings.evidence: The new code paints a blank at fixed cell (3,3), using literal foreground/background RGB #173f1c, after paint_pinned_split and manager_help::draw. This is explicitly a visual correction for the manager gutter. It does not change actual focus, layer scope or input routing. It violates the requirement to fix focus/inactive-layer appearance in shared component/theme rules instead of repainting widget pixels in the application.
new_findings.repair: Remove the correction when the real shared manager/tree and modal help lifecycle own inactive-layer state. Pass the shared state/style policy once; do not move or rename this blanking patch, and do not restore HistoricalPalette.

newly_demonstrated_inherited_product_fin.title: Visible manager help is a renderer without its modal input/update lifecycle
newly_demonstrated_inherited_product_fin.classification: Present on both exact parent 48 and candidate 25; not claimed as newly introduced by 25.
newly_demonstrated_inherited_product_fin.evidence: Opening ? leaves the top layer at LayerId(0). Down changes the background manager selection from Workspace(1) to Workspace(2). The real rendered Done control has a registration, but clicking it does not close help. The app sets help_open/status, draws HelpOverlay with a fresh default state, and never calls its update method or opens its layer. All three public Runtime probes fail on both revisions.
newly_demonstrated_inherited_product_fin.frozen_evidence: Frozen app.rs:1058 constructs HelpOverlay::from_keymaps and calls open_layer; app_tests_layers.rs:155 requires a top HelpOverlay. Frozen app_tests_pointer.rs:56 drives its real scrollbar and checks changing scroll state.
newly_demonstrated_inherited_product_fin.repair: Use the shared HelpOverlay layer, one persistent public HelpOverlayState, update/draw configuration, and typed close actions. Let the shared layer block background interaction and restore focus; remove manual underlay geometry and focus blanking.
